text:
emily_rm: Heads-up: we pushed model v5.1.0-alpha to a 10% canary in US-Central ~15m ago. Observability flags a subtle p95 increase for large-batch embedding requests. Change window starts in 25m.

deploybot: [deploy] Canary v5.1.0-alpha rolled to 10% (us-central) at 2026-03-21T13:05Z. Auto-rollback thresholds active.

kevin: p95 baseline ~95ms. Canary slices showing ~190ms on batched embedding jobs. Error counts normal. Could be batching config mismatch or kernel path differences.

ops_lead: Proposal: don't trigger global auto-rollback. Instead, 1) set a targeted pin for Dedicated pools to v5.0.x, 2) perform traffic-slice rollback for the canary slice if p95 > 2x baseline for two 5-min windows.

nora: Agree. We should avoid churn for Dedicated customers. I'll prep the release-note snippet and incident-free customer message: "temporary routing change to ensure stable latencies".

ryan: Runbook for targeted pin:
```
# pin dedicated pools to v5.0.9
redwoodctl pools patch --pool dedicated-* --model v5.0.9 --reason "canary p95 regression"
# rollback canary slice if needed
redwoodctl rollout update --slice us-central --model v5.0.9 --traffic 10%
```

ops_lead: Also adding a manual hold to autopilot for this release for the change window duration. We'll evaluate after KV-cache traces.

cs_manager: Notifying two enterprise customers on dedicated pools now as a precaution. They'll want an ETA. Keep me posted.

deploybot: [deploybot] Autopilot hold applied by ops_lead for v5.1.0-alpha at 2026-03-21T13:24Z.

emily_rm: OK execute the targeted pin on Dedicated pools; do not roll back canary yet. kevin & infra, run the kernel selection trace and batching config diff.

kevin: Executing trace now. Initial hypothesis: runtime falls back to slower kernel for batched sequences >4k tokens. Dumping trace and will attach to ticket.

ops_lead: If p95 worsens for the canary (two windows), sam will perform slice rollback. sam standby.

sam: Standing by. If I roll back, I'll first post a short internal note and then run the command.

cs_manager: Customers acknowledged the precautionary note; asked for regular updates every 30m until resolved.

kevin: Trace shows additional memcpy on the v5.1 path that explains ~60-80ms overhead on large batches. Filing bug against runtime/kernel selection.

ops_lead: Thanks. We'll keep autopilot off and keep change window open. No re-roll forward until patch + perf regression test pass.
